shared_elements: horizontal registers/bands of repeated small figures
justification: The only real correspondence is the organisation of small profile figures — including animal forms — into stacked horizontal registers across a rectangular field, a very generic device; A's lower registers of sign-like figures superficially echo B's rows of animals. But A is dominated by a specific scene of two facing human figures flanking an offering stand with raised-arm gesture and dense symbolic script, none of which appears in B, whose content is purely rows of quadrupeds and serpentine/curved animal forms with no human figures or interaction.
